facts.text: Caroline's painting 'Embracing Identity' represents the journey of self-acceptance and comfort in being oneself.

evidence.quote: Here's one- 'Embracing Identity' is all about finding comfort and love in being yourself. The woman in the painting stands for the journey of acceptance.
Art's allowed me to explore my transition and my changing body. It's been a great way to work through stuff I'm going through.

facts.text: Caroline uses art as a means to explore her transition and changing body, helping her work through personal challenges.

evidence.quote: Art's allowed me to explore my transition and my changing body. It's been a great way to work through stuff I'm going through.

facts.text: Caroline's art aims to express her trans experience and help others understand the trans community.

evidence.quote: My art is about expressing my trans experience. It's my way of showing my story and helping people understand the trans community.

facts.text: Caroline's art emphasizes the beauty of imperfections and self-acceptance.

evidence.quote: My aim was to show warmth, love and self-acceptance.
It's awesome that beauty can be found in the imperfections.
